title: Gift shop in Duluth, Georgia
assumptions: An existing company. Hires staff. Moves into the space as it is (no build-out) with no new sign.

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.note: IRS: "You never have to pay a fee for an EIN."

items.name: Sales and use tax number and certificate of registration
items.quote: must register for a sales and use tax number and certificate of registration regardless of whether all sales will be online, out of state, wholesale, or exempt from tax.

items.name: Unemployment insurance tax account (DOL-1A)
items.quote: You must complete an Application for GDOL Tax Account or Status Change (DOL-1A) form and return it to the Georgia Department of Labor

items.name: Business zoning and use certificate
items.agency: City of Duluth Planning and Development
items.match: (zoning (use|and use)|zoning verification|use certificate).*(duluth)|(duluth).*(zoning (use|and use)|zoning verification|use certificate)

items.name: Occupational Tax Certificate (business license)
items.quote: Every business in the City is required to apply for an Occupational Tax Certificate (OTC) and renew it annually in order to operate in the City limits.

order.why: Zoning use verification is step 1; the certificate application follows Planning approval.

mustNotInclude.name: Any food permit, food handler or plan review
mustNotInclude.why: A store that sells no food needs no food permit.

mustNotInclude.name: Atlanta's or Fulton County's permits
mustNotInclude.why: Duluth is its own city in Gwinnett County.
